# warpbuild_stack (Data Source)

Looks up a single stack (runner infrastructure deployment). Use its `id` as `stack_id` on runner images and `provider_id` on runners.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "warpbuild_stack" "ec2" {
  alias = "my-ec2-stack"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `alias` (String) Stack alias to look up.
- `kind` (String) Stack kind filter. Defaults to `ec2`.
- `region` (String) Region filter (e.g. `us-east-1`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stack ID.
- `status` (String) Stack status.
